page_title: UNI 1-1 EIN | Union Berlin v Eintracht Frankfurt 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+7' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+4' The attendance is 22012.
90+3' The goal by Union Berlin won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
90+2' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Union Berlin players aren’t happy.
90+1' What a goal! Laszlo Benes plays it to Tim Skarke (Union Berlin), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Kevin Trapp into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Harm Osmers didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar.
88' It seemed like Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
87' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) for Yorbe Vertessen.
84' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Trapp intercepts the ball.
82' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ansgar Knauff will be replaced by Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt).
82' A substitution has been made. Omar Marmoush goes off and Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
77' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
76' Here comes a substitution. Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Benedict Hollerbach.
74' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
71' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
66' 1 - 1 Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
66' Attention! Referee Harm Osmers straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
66' A goal, which was scored by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), was disallowed due to offside.
65' Substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Woo-Yeong Jeong walks off.
65' It is time for a substitution. Robert Skov (Union Berlin) is on for Tom Rothe.
65' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Hugo Ekitike.
65' Substitution. Mario Gotze leaves the pitch and is replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein will be replaced by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin).
64' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off the line to clear the ball away.

60' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Kevin Trapp is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
56' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
55' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Union Berlin was in an offside position.
52' Harm Osmers blows for a foul after Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
51' What an opportunity! Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) smashed a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but the ball only crashed against the left post!
49' Woo-Yeong Jeong (Union Berlin) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) wins himself just enough space to meet the corner and shoots. The shot goes towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow makes a decent save and thwarts the effort. Eintracht Frankfurt force their opponents to concede a corner.
45' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) will take the corner.
39' A rebound falls kindly for Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
38' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
38' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Rasmus Kristensen is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt).
38' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
38' It will be a corner kick for Union Berlin.
37' The injury to Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
37' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' Yorbe Vertessen sprays a pass out to Tom Rothe (Union Berlin), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
33' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
30' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

29' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Kevin Trapp, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
24' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) dribbles into the box, but Frederik Ronnow is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
21' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Harm Osmers had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Union Berlin string together a series of short passes.
17' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
17' The resulting corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
14' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ellyes Skhiri sprays a pass out to Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
14' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
11' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
6' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but it's cleared.
4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
3' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
1' The match has just started.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Harm Osmers.
